notes: Co-brand credit card with Korean Air SKYPASS, issued by U.S. Bank. On 2026-10-19 the official visaSecuredCard.do page explicitly states in its meta description: 'This product is no longer available.' Unlike the SkyBlue product page, the secured page offers no product-specific application link or current offer. The contact page lists existing-account servicing, not availability to new applicants. No official withdrawal date or successor is stated, so neither is inferred. Historical annual fees and earning rates are not documented on the remaining pages and are left unknown. This verification covers the unavailable-product notice and servicing identity, not a refresh of historical terms. Existing artwork attribution and official Source order are retained.
